title: PrecedentPack
description: The product of a commissioner's tenure, transmitted to its successor after three passings. The instance is disposable; the pack is the asset. It must be sufficient on its own — the successor is seated only after reproducing established outcomes on sealed historical cases without access to its predecessor.

adjudications.description: Total rounds participated in. Hard backstop at 12 forces rotation even for a seat that only ever dissents.

approved_patterns.description: What gets a PASS, and why. Citations are mandatory so a successor can read the actual cases.

rejected_patterns.description: What does not get approved. Fed back into Implementer and Refiner context packs so the fleet learns the standard and first-round dissent rate falls over time.

remediation_that_worked.description: Turns the Commission from a gate that says no into a body that teaches what yes looks like.

calibration.description: The seat's record of being wrong. A successor inheriting this starts calibrated instead of repeating the same errors for three more rounds.

precision.description: upheld ÷ (upheld + overturned). Below 0.7 the seat is noisy and blocking good work.

escaped_defects.description: Production defects in this seat's jurisdiction that it passed. Any value above 0 means too lenient.

false_dissent_rate_q.description: Spurious dissent probability on genuinely good work. The Commission's vital sign: clean work is accepted with probability (1-q)^10.

jurisdiction_notes.description: Boundary cases where this seat nearly encroached on another's jurisdiction.

binding_precedents.description: Human arbitration rulings. Written into the packs of both seats involved in a contradiction so the same conflict is resolved by precedent next time rather than by another human.

open_questions.description: Cases this instance ruled inconsistently on, handed forward honestly rather than hidden.

bench_exam.description: Successor's validated handoff. Graded against sealed ground truth, never against the predecessor's pack — otherwise succession degrades into a game of telephone.
